open_release.rationale: The sources frame graph generation for molecule design and never as releasing synthetic data in place of real data.

pipeline_testing.rationale: No testing or format-conformance framing appears.

ml_augmentation.rationale: Evaluation is by validity, uniqueness and distribution metrics; no train-on-synthetic or augmentation framing.

statistical_replication.rationale: The paper evaluates how well generated graphs capture the data distribution using graph statistics.

quotes.text: the data distribution very effectively, with significant improvements over baselines on planar graphs.

causal_inference.rationale: No causal structure framing in the sources.

education.rationale: The README is installation and run instructions only.

benchmarking.rationale: DiGress is evaluated on existing benchmarks against baselines but is not shown used as a baseline in these sources.
